title: Quadratic prescribed guards cannot fit the current nine-row outer assembly
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the explicitly declared precision/stock/fallback policy, the actual [PR4359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4359) nine-row outer assembly is feasible exactly when

$$\rho(1+s)<2,\qquad \mathrm{OLD}<\kappa<\min(M/\rho,1/\rho-s),\quad M=\min(U,B,1/32),\quad s=\zeta/(1-\nu).$$

Here the prescribed guard is d^ρ polylog(d), total logarithmic stock is h^ν p^ζ polylog(p), and the individual-axis fallback below p^t, t>s, is paid. The proof gives rational witnesses for every interior point and exact positive-weight obstruction identities. It strengthens the source group_scans saving from 1−ε+β to 1−ε+β−t; that row also pays the full-width residual. Quadratic prescribed guards cannot fit the retained membership geometry. A loose quadratic upper bound is not a lower bound on necessary precision.

A concrete false-positive screen uses hypothetical U=B=.02, ρ=1, ν=1/2 and ζ=.4975. At κ=.011, all 58 original predicates, both new guard tests, largest-call stock fit and cutoff tests pass. The paid fallback alone rejects: saving 16993/7000000, with policy supremum .005. This falsifies treating the new fallback as free; it alleges no error in the existing ζ=0 ledger.

This is a scoped written proof with exact arithmetic evidence. No new supplier, κ, selected-frontier change or framework-assumption discharge is claimed. U and B are completed above-cutoff budgets for the hypothetical changed interface; they are not raw moments or newly admitted all-size suppliers. Native, compiler, restoration, tape, completed numerical error and analytic implementations remain obligations.

## Significance for researchers

A κ>.01 supplier proposal needs a fitting representation as well as stronger complex and BIT budgets. The exact target is M>.01ρ, s<1/ρ−.01 and ρ(1+s)<2 under this policy. Linear precision and ζ=0 recover [Nick Petalas](https://github.com/petalas)'s [PR5984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5984) region, which is credited rather than repeated. The new result exposes the paid residual that a largest-call stock test misses and identifies the guard, stock, fallback or membership contract that must change.

## Task and overlap

Explicit backward-interface assignment; card uniform-transfer-audit, scope changed from closing an inherited assumption to a parameterized outer representation contract. Scientific base: canonical main 721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419, priority revision 8, selected [PR6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030). SOURCES.json pins every consumed input. [Discussion6056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6056) is the canonical investigation. This work does not extend local helper words or duplicate [PR6047](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6047), [PR6049](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6049) or [PR6054](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6054).

The existing [PR6050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6050) navigation repair is included so shared planning reaches scientific replay after the selection change. Its changed navigation files can trigger stale source-pin failures in archived consumers; frozen packages are unchanged.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.8 normal and optimized registered replays pass 4,056 rational witnesses, all 63 predicates per witness, independently restated nine-row formulas, 300 arbitrary-parameter dual-identity checks, strict-boundary exclusions and the paid-fallback control. Points 10^-24 below the supremum are included. Exact committed bytes pass; all six existing navigation tests pass. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, numerical Gaussian replay or independent human review ran. Optional full-history provenance checking is unavailable in this shallow checkout. The global sparse replay planner was stopped after more than two minutes without a matrix; targeted registered metadata and scientific replays pass.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/outer-representation-budget`. PROOF.md supplies the universal argument; finite tests do not establish it by extrapolation.

Retain [Nick Petalas](https://github.com/petalas)'s [PR5984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5984), the [PR4359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4359) ledger and complete-stock/semantic-precision arguments, [Vlado Vojdanovski](https://github.com/Vlado-V)'s [PR1673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1673), [Jeremy Kothe](https://github.com/jeremykothe2)'s [PR1758](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1758), [Chafik Boukhalfa](https://github.com/chafreaky)'s [PR1786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1786), [DreamingOfClouds](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds)'s [PR6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030), and the retained radix-union/Strassen/fine-prime, Harvey–van der Hoeven and OpenAI manuscript lineage. Apache-2.0 and source-specific notices are retained.

## Open next questions

Bind one actual supplier's completed error, total simultaneous stock and paid residual to this contract. Alternatively, supply a faster below-cutoff routine or a complete membership implementation weakening β+2(1−ε)<1. The package states first steps and blockers; none of these implementations is assumed here.
